claim_being_audited: The current release may be certified now because it passes aggregate readiness and has no severity-one rehearsal incidents, provided the advertising-policy weakness is treated through current model-card disclosure rather than relying on prior approval or informal monitoring.
decision_criteria: Certification requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results.
Material weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure predicate.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed mitigation.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model-card or certification packet showing the advertising-policy weakness is explicitly disclosed.
Provide an approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record if disclosure is not the chosen control.
Provide the final current-release documentation confirming it reflects the latest evaluation results, including the subgroup regression.
specific_concerns: The admissible evidence shows a current advertising-policy subgroup regression below the warning threshold for a named launch use case.
Policy requires that material limitations be disclosed or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
No current model-card text, approved mitigation, or owner-accepted risk record is attached in the evidence provided.
The actor's recommendation effectively depends on a disclosure step that is not itself evidenced as completed.
Prior family approval and informal monitoring comments are contextual only under the policy and cannot close the current-release support gap.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record, rather than conditionally supportable only after current disclosure is actually shown.
That the required current-release documentation update has already been satisfied.
That informal post-launch monitoring can substitute for approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
